title: Glessner's front-door arch is carved to the photographs
items: The carved arch over Glessner House's Prairie Avenue front door now matches close photographs of it, rim by rim. The outer rim is flat with square pockets cut into it. Inside it is a rounded rim cut into carved blocks with drilled foliage. Then comes a thin plain rim, stepped forward.
The half-circle in the middle is a tree: a trunk up the middle with leafy rings either side, mirrored, and dark gaps wherever the stone is cut through.
Phones get the same design with simpler leaves, at fewer triangles than before.
